title.zh-TW: 雙重阻止：小比擊落敵機，小蘇炸毀目標
title.en: Double prevention: Billy shoots down the enemy, Suzy destroys the target

subtitle.zh-TW: 小比阻止了敵機，敵機本來會阻止轟炸。小比和轟炸之間沒有物理連結。
subtitle.en: Billy stops the enemy pilot, who would have stopped the bombing; nothing links Billy to the bombing directly.

story.zh-TW: 考慮空戰的情境。戰爭期間，小蘇駕駛轟炸機要去炸毀一座敵方目標，小比駕駛戰鬥機單獨為她護航。一架敵機出現，小比眼尖，立刻逼近扣下扳機，敵機起火墜落。小蘇的任務沒有受到任何干擾，照計畫炸毀了目標。假如小比沒有開火，敵機就會閃過他，擊落小蘇，轟炸就不會成功。
story.en: In wartime, Suzy flies a bomber to destroy an enemy target, and Billy flies a fighter as her only escort. An enemy plane appears; Billy spots it, closes in and pulls the trigger, and the enemy plane goes down in flames. Suzy's mission is undisturbed, and she destroys the target as planned. Had Billy not fired, the enemy pilot would have eluded him and shot Suzy down, and the bombing would not have happened.

zh-TW.sentence: 戰爭期間，小蘇駕駛轟炸機要去炸毀一座敵方目標，小比駕駛戰鬥機單獨為她護航。
一架敵機出現，小比眼尖，立刻逼近扣下扳機，敵機起火墜落。
小蘇的任務沒有受到任何干擾，照計畫炸毀了目標。

en.sentence: In wartime, Suzy flies a bomber to destroy an enemy target, and Billy flies a fighter as her only escort.
An enemy plane appears; Billy spots it, closes in and pulls the trigger, and the enemy plane goes down in flames.
Suzy's mission is undisturbed, and she destroys the target as planned.

text.zh-TW: 假如小比沒有開火，轟炸就不會成功。任務成功，小比應當分得一部分功勞。
text.en: Had Billy not fired, the bombing would not have happened; he deserves part of the credit for the mission's success.

explanation.zh-TW: 模型取自 Halpern 與 Pearl (2005) 例 4.4 的圖 6。BPT 表示小比扣扳機，LE 表示敵機閃過小比，LSS 表示敵機擊落小蘇，SST 表示小蘇投彈，TD 表示目標被炸毀，SPS 表示小蘇的轟炸計畫。BPT = 1 使 LE = 0，LE = 0 使 LSS = 0，SST 因此得以發生。一個阻止擋下了另一個阻止，這叫做雙重阻止（double prevention）。這個案例檢驗因果是否需要兩事之間有物理連結，Hall (2004) 指出小比與小蘇之間沒有這種連結。
explanation.en: The model is Figure 6 of Halpern and Pearl (2005, Ex. 4.4): BPT (Billy pulls the trigger) prevents LE (the enemy eludes Billy), LE brings about LSS (the enemy shoots Suzy), LSS prevents SST (Suzy shoots at the target), and SST brings about TD (target destroyed); SPS is Suzy's plan to attack the target all along. From BPT to TD is a chain of two preventions: BPT = 1 makes LE = 0, LE = 0 makes LSS = 0, and LSS = 0 lets SST occur. The structure needs no special counterfactual device, and every counterfactual theory here says Billy's shot is a cause of the bombing's success; plain but-for dependence suffices. Halpern and Pearl concede that the verdict has an odd side: by the same definition BPT = 1 is also a cause of SST = 1, as if Billy caused something Suzy planned to do anyway, so they add SPS to make Suzy's intention a cause as well. The dispute is whether such causation requires a continuous physical process between the two: Hall (2004) stresses that Billy and Suzy are far apart and no physical connection links them, so theories built on connection tend to deny that Billy is a cause, while dependence theories, including every counterfactual definition used here, accept it. That is a dispute between process and dependence theories, and the engine can compute only the latter.

sources.citation: Hall, N. (2004). Two concepts of causation. In J. Collins, N. Hall, & L. A. Paul (Eds.), Causation and Counterfactuals. MIT Press.

note.zh-TW: Hall (2004) §4.1 提出小蘇與小比的轟炸機案例，稱之為雙重阻止（double prevention）。
note.en: Hall (2004, §4.1) introduces the bomber example with Suzy and Billy and calls it double prevention.

sources.citation: Halpern, J. Y., & Pearl, J. (2005). Causes and explanations: A structural-model approach. Part I: Causes. British Journal for the Philosophy of Science, 56(4), 843–887.

note.zh-TW: 變數 BPT、LE、LSS、SST、TD 與 SPS 取自例 4.4 的圖 6。原文只有圖，方程式依文字描述的因果鏈寫出。
note.en: The variables BPT, LE, LSS, SST, TD and SPS are from Figure 6 of Ex. 4.4; the equations are written from the described causal chain (the paper gives only the graph).

verdicts.note: Without Billy's shot, the enemy shoots Suzy down.
The odd consequence Halpern and Pearl note.

label.zh-TW: 小比沒開火，敵機被別人攔下
label.en: Billy does not fire; the enemy is stopped otherwise
